title: Concrete supported functors and ordinary rationalization
statement: For a scheme X, an object U of its pro-etale site, and a topological commutative ring T, openSliceModules U T is module pushforward along the explicit equivalence (X_proet)/U -> U_proet, with the sectionwise identity coefficient map. For f: X -> Y, continuousModuleDirectImage f T is scalar restriction along the canonical adjoint continuous-function map f^{-1}T_Y -> T_X, followed by ringed direct image with coefficients T_Y. continuousModuleExtensionByZero U T is openSliceModules followed by the concrete ringed slice extension by zero. For prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l, integralModelRationalize l E X M is the actual sheafified sectionwise change of rings along the continuous inclusion of its valuation-subring coefficient sheaf into its WithAbs field coefficient sheaf. These are the original four constructions, with their bodies and types unchanged.

proof.text: These are explicit functor compositions and the published sheafified ordinary tensor construction. Their bodies are unchanged from the original item.

def openSliceModules {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.ProEt)
    (T : Type u) [TopologicalSpace T] [CommRing T] [IsTopologicalRing T] :
    SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (latticeModuleRing U.left T) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((latticeModuleRing X T).over U)
